channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Wicklow and Louth record second wins as Leitrim get up and running
item.description: Wicklow secured their second wins in the Allianz Hurling League Division 3 by seeing off Tyrone on a 3-14 to 0-15 scoreline in Garvagher this afternoon.

item.title: Ladies: First-half goals help Galway to victory over Kildare in Tuam
item.description: Galway returned to winning ways against Kildare in Division 1 of the Lidl National Ladies Football League in Tuam Stadium.

item.title: Late Reynolds goal sees Longford snatch both points from Waterford
item.description: Longford edged out Waterford by 2-18 to 3-14 in Dungarvan this afternoon to secure their first points in Division 4 of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: Ladies: O'Shea stars as Kerry see off Meath for second win
item.description: The old adage goals win games proved true as Kerry got back to winning ways when they defeated Meath in an entertaining contest in the Lidl NFL Division 1 game played at the Meath Hill GAA Grounds.

item.title: Lidl National Football League: Waterford preserve 100% record as Galway and Kerry claim wins
item.description: IN-form Waterford made it three wins from three in Division 1 of the Lidl National League on Saturday.

item.title: Ruthless Clare hit Down for 3-35 while Kildare open account in Division 1B
item.description: Clare cruised to their third straight win in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League by seeing off Down on an emphatic 3-35 to 0-15 scoreline in Ennis this afternoon.

item.title: Westmeath claim spoils in Division 2 derby
item.description: Westmeath edged Meath by 0-25 to 1-19 in Mullingar this afternoon to claim their first Allianz Hurling League Division 2 victory of the season.

item.title: Halloran hits 1-12 as Waterford condemn Offaly to third defeat
item.description: Waterford picked up their second win of the Allianz Hurling League Division 1A campaign by handing Offaly a 1-19 to 0-16 defeat at Walsh Park this afternoon.

item.title: Gillane goal helps Treaty men past Cats for first league win
item.description: Limerick earned their first points in this year's Allianz Hurling League campaign by handing Kilkenny a 1-26 to 2-16 defeat the TUS Gaelic Grounds this afternoon.
